## Summary

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests pass
- [ ] `make proof` passes, or unavailable KVM coverage is explained
- [ ] Guest byte changes include updated `ARTIFACTS.manifest` and `SHA256SUMS`
- [ ] New dependencies and provenance are documented
- [ ] Commits include `Signed-off-by`

## Byte Budget

For guest changes, list the before/after size and affected symbols.
